facts.text: **Serbia**: the student movement born of the **1 Nov 2024 Novi Sad** railway canopy collapse (16 dead; a Belgrade-Budapest rail project backed by China's **BRI**) won the **25 Oct** snap election — the **'Student List'** took **141 of 250** seats against **103** for **Aleksandar Vucic's SNS**, ending 14 years of SNS rule. Lead candidate: cardiologist **Ilija Srdanovic**.
facts.plain: Serbia: the student movement born of the 1 Nov 2024 Novi Sad railway canopy collapse (16 dead; a Belgrade-Budapest rail project backed by China's BRI) won the 25 Oct snap election — the 'Student List' took 141 of 250 seats against 103 for Aleksandar Vucic's SNS, ending 14 years of SNS rule. Lead candidate: cardiologist Ilija Srdanovic.

facts.text: Israel's 27 Oct election had the highest turnout since 1999 (**77.7%**); **Arab citizens** (about **20%** of the population) voted at nearly 80%. The **Joint List** (Balad, Hadash, Ta'al) and **Ra'am** (Mansour Abbas) won **19** seats, their best ever. Ra'am was the first Arab party in a government in nearly 44 years (**2021**, Bennett-Lapid).
facts.plain: Israel's 27 Oct election had the highest turnout since 1999 (77.7%); Arab citizens (about 20% of the population) voted at nearly 80%. The Joint List (Balad, Hadash, Ta'al) and Ra'am (Mansour Abbas) won 19 seats, their best ever. Ra'am was the first Arab party in a government in nearly 44 years (2021, Bennett-Lapid).

facts.text: **Lula da Silva** won the runoff on **25 Oct**, the first Brazilian president to finish **second** in the first round (4 Oct) and still win; this is his **fourth** term (earlier 2003-2010 and 2023-26). Born **27 Oct 1945** in **Pernambuco**; a metalworker and union leader, he co-founded the **Workers' Party (PT)** on **10 Feb 1980**. Rival **Flavio Bolsonaro** fled to Florida, claiming persecution.
facts.plain: Lula da Silva won the runoff on 25 Oct, the first Brazilian president to finish second in the first round (4 Oct) and still win; this is his fourth term (earlier 2003-2010 and 2023-26). Born 27 Oct 1945 in Pernambuco; a metalworker and union leader, he co-founded the Workers' Party (PT) on 10 Feb 1980. Rival Flavio Bolsonaro fled to Florida, claiming persecution.

facts.text: Bhutan's **Project 108** (announced by King **Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk** on 26 Feb): **108 jangchub chortens**, each **15 m** tall, **108 m** apart along **12 km** of the **Mau Chhu** river in **Gelephu**, built on **1 Nov** (Buddha's Descending Day, Mother's Day, the King's **18th coronation anniversary**). Most relics are of Indian origin; each costs about **$200,000**.
facts.plain: Bhutan's Project 108 (announced by King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk on 26 Feb): 108 jangchub chortens, each 15 m tall, 108 m apart along 12 km of the Mau Chhu river in Gelephu, built on 1 Nov (Buddha's Descending Day, Mother's Day, the King's 18th coronation anniversary). Most relics are of Indian origin; each costs about $200,000.
